country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_SOV.10
	title = COLDWAR_SOV.10.t
	desc = COLDWAR_SOV.10.d
	picture = GFX_news_event_SOV_supreme_soviet

	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SOV.10"
		# extra sessions do not move the calendar
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_extra_session }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_extra_session
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_session_half = 0 } }
				set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_session_half = 1 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.10 days = 184 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_session_half = 0 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.10 days = 181 }
			}
			if = { limit = { date > 1970.12.20 date < 1971.1.20 check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan < 9 } } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan = 9 } COLDWAR_SOV_start_plan = yes }
			if = { limit = { date > 1975.12.20 date < 1976.1.20 check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan < 10 } } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan = 10 } COLDWAR_SOV_start_plan = yes }
			if = { limit = { date > 1980.12.20 date < 1981.1.20 check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan < 11 } } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan = 11 } COLDWAR_SOV_start_plan = yes }
			if = { limit = { date > 1985.12.20 date < 1986.1.20 check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan < 12 } } set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan = 12 } COLDWAR_SOV_start_plan = yes }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_patron_in_moscow } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_proposal_made
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.15 } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SOV.10.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_SOV.80
	title = COLDWAR_SOV.80.t
	desc = COLDWAR_SOV.80.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_communist_congress

	is_triggered_only = yes
	hidden = yes

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SOV.80"
		clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_congress_open
		every_country = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_SOV_is_union_republic = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_applied NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat } }
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bid_25 } add_political_power = 12 }
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bid_50 } add_political_power = 25 }
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bid_100 } add_political_power = 50 }
			}
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bid_25
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bid_50
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_bid_100
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_cadre_protection
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_slanderer } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_slanderer }
			if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_in_disgrace }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_disgrace_left = -1 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_disgrace_left < 1 } } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_in_disgrace }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_rotate_cadres NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_SOV_seat_changed_this_congress } check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_seat_count > 0 } }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.81 days = 1 }
		}
		news_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.37 hours = 6 }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SOV.80.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_SOV.100
	title = COLDWAR_SOV.100.t
	desc = COLDWAR_SOV.100.d
	picture = GFX_baku_gas_lines_country

	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SOV.100.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 60
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_war_with = FROM }
			modifier = { factor = 1.5 check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension > 60 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { global.mdcw_cw_tension < 30 } }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SOV.100 option a"
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_SOV_soviet_gas } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_SOV_soviet_gas }
		set_temp_variable = { receiver_nation = THIS.id }
		set_temp_variable = { sender_nation = FROM.id }
		set_improved_trade_agreement = yes
		FROM = {
			add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_SOV_offer_gas_for_pipes bonus = 0.5 uses = 1 category = CAT_infrastructure }
		}
		FROM = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_gosplan_modifier } } } hidden_effect = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_SOV_gosplan_modifier } } }
			custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_SOV_gosplan_modifier }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_gosplan_trade_opinion_factor = 0.1 tooltip = COLDWAR_SOV_mod_trade_opinion_factor_tt }
			hidden_effect = { force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
		}
		FROM = {
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share = 0.005 }
			COLDWAR_SOV_receive_gdp_share = yes
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_SOV_gdp_share = 0.005 }
			COLDWAR_SOV_change_debt_gdp_share = yes
		}
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.900 days = 1 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_SOV.100.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_SOV.100 option b"
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SOV.901 days = 1 } }
	}
}
